svg.title: Reconcile $425,000 Revenue to $127,500 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-owner-net-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Reconcile $425,000 Revenue to $127,500 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars: recognized revenue, four operating-cost deductions, and a final 30.0% owner-net total.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Annual USD. The first and final bars are absolute totals; the four intervening bars are negative movements. The final bar is not another additive movement. Cost allocations are illustrative but reconcile exactly to the canonical Base scenario. The $57,500 combined software and administration budget averages $4,791.67 monthly, within the $2,000–$12,000 standing-opex range; variable delivery and acquisition costs are additional. Owner net is before personal income taxes and owner distributions; no separate founder salary is deducted in this allocation.; caption: $425,000 − $150,000 − $90,000 − $24,000 − $33,500 = $127,500. Canonical annual scenarios remain Conservative $100,000 at 20% = $20,000; Base $425,000 at 30.0% = $127,500; Scaled $750,000 at 40% = $300,000. Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 4 C.; stages: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: Start with $425,000 in earned service revenue.; numeric value: 425000.0; detail: Recognize $365,000 of annual retainers plus $60,000 of accepted-appointment fees. Exclude client advertising pass-through, client contract value, and client sales proceeds.; label: Delivery labor and fulfillment; value: Deduct $150,000 for contracted service delivery capacity.; numeric value: -150000.0; detail: Budget the three contractor seats, appointment handling, quality review, and rework inside this delivery envelope. The remaining annual contribution becomes $275,000.; label: Operator-funded acquisition; value: Deduct $90,000 for operator-paid acquisition and sourcing.; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Include direct prospect sourcing and operator-funded campaign acquisition expenses, not client-funded advertising pass-through. Do not duplicate standing software costs. The remaining contribution becomes $185,000.; label: Software and communications; value: Deduct $24,000 for the standing operating stack.; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Budget CRM, authorized mailboxes, telephony, scheduling, and reporting subscriptions at $2,000 monthly. Keep usage charges in one cost category. Remaining contribution is $161,000.; label: Administration and service overhead; value: Deduct $33,500 for administration and operating overhead.; numeric value: -33500.0; detail: Cover bookkeeping, insurance, payment processing, contract review, and general business administration. This final expense deduction leaves exactly $127,500 of annual owner net.; label: Annual owner net total; value: Finish with $127,500, exactly 30.0% of revenue.; numeric value: 127500.0; detail: Render this endpoint as an absolute total from zero. Annual modeled expenses total $297,500, or 70% of recognized operator revenue; the founder occupies the full-time seat.

circle.title: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: Start with $425,000 in earned service revenue.; numeric value: 425000.0; detail: Recognize $365,000 of annual retainers plus $60,000 of accepted-appointment fees. Exclude client advertising pass-through, client contract value, and client sales proceeds.

label: Delivery labor and fulfillment; value: Deduct $150,000 for contracted service delivery capacity.; numeric value: -150000.0; detail: Budget the three contractor seats, appointment handling, quality review, and rework inside this delivery envelope. The remaining annual contribution becomes $275,000.

label: Operator-funded acquisition; value: Deduct $90,000 for operator-paid acquisition and sourcing.; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Include direct prospect sourcing and operator-funded campaign acquisition expenses, not client-funded advertising pass-through. Do not duplicate standing software costs. The remaining contribution becomes $185,000.

label: Software and communications; value: Deduct $24,000 for the standing operating stack.; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Budget CRM, authorized mailboxes, telephony, scheduling, and reporting subscriptions at $2,000 monthly. Keep usage charges in one cost category. Remaining contribution is $161,000.

label: Administration and service overhead; value: Deduct $33,500 for administration and operating overhead.; numeric value: -33500.0; detail: Cover bookkeeping, insurance, payment processing, contract review, and general business administration. This final expense deduction leaves exactly $127,500 of annual owner net.

label: Annual owner net total; value: Finish with $127,500, exactly 30.0% of revenue.; numeric value: 127500.0; detail: Render this endpoint as an absolute total from zero. Annual modeled expenses total $297,500, or 70% of recognized operator revenue; the founder occupies the full-time seat.

The $57,500 combined software and administration budget averages $4,791.67 monthly, within the $2,000–$12,000 standing-opex range; variable delivery and acquisition costs are additional. Owner net is before personal income taxes and owner distributions; no separate founder salary is deducted in this allocation.
